turn: I finished the "Rounding for invoice totals" step by adding a test, test_many_small_lines, in tests/invoices/test_totals.py. It builds three lines of 0.0049 each and checks that invoice_total returns 0.01. That result shows the total is rounded once, after the lines are summed. Rounding each line first would give 0.00. I didn't run the test suite in this session, so the new test hasn't been confirmed passing. While I was in the same commit, I also fixed a small unplanned issue: the Line import in the test module pointed at a stale path, so I corrected it. Next I'll start "Rounding for VAT lines".
